dryRun.label: Dry run mode (log only - no DMs, no bans)
dryRun.helpText: When enabled, OffenseLog tracks violations and computes tiers but does NOT send warning DMs, ban users, or send the user-facing good-standing DM. Modmail notifications still fire (prefixed with [DRY RUN]) so you can see what the system would have done. Recommended for the first week after install.

warningMessage.label: Warning DM message
warningMessage.defaultValue: You have received multiple content removals. Please review the community rules.

banMessage.label: Ban message
banMessage.defaultValue: You have been banned due to rule violations.

modmailLevel.label: Modmail notification level (all | bans | off)
modmailLevel.helpText: Controls escalation/de-escalation modmail volume. 'all' = every tier change (default). 'bans' = only when a temp ban or perma ban is issued (Tier 2/3). 'off' = no escalation modmail (the acting moderator still gets a DM). Use 'bans' or 'off' on high-volume subs.

ruleWhitelist.label: Rule whitelist (one per line)
ruleWhitelist.helpText:
Rules in this list won't count as violations. Match the rule name exactly as it appears in your removal reasons (case-insensitive). Leave blank to disable.

Example:
Duplicate post
Wrong flair

ruleWeights.label: Rule weights (one per line, format: rule_name: weight)
ruleWeights.helpText:
Override the default weight of 1 for specific rules. Higher = counts more toward escalation. Use 0 to exclude (whitelist also works). Case-insensitive. Format is 'rule name: number'.

Example:
Harassment: 3
Hate speech: 5
Low-effort: 0
